System Requirements

Hardware and software specifications for running Verixa BIM Suite.

Supported Environments

  • Autodesk Revit: 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 (64-bit).
  • Operating System: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit).
  • RAM: 8 GB minimum (16 GB+ recommended for large BIM models).
  • GPU: DirectX 11 capable graphics card for Helix 3D Family Preview.

Professional BIM productivity ecosystem for Autodesk Revit. Streamline 3D family management, automated drafting, clash detection, and layout presentations.
